Sink & kitchen industry news

We make a cleaner for composite, granite and quartz sinks, so we keep a close eye on the companies that make the sinks themselves. This page gathers the day's headlines on new sink ranges, colours and materials, boiling-water taps, worktops and the wider kitchen and bathroom trade, so you can see what's new in one place.

Each headline links to the full story on the publisher's own website, and opens in a new tab. We show only the headline, the publisher, the date and a short extract; the stories and their copyright belong to the publishers. Sponsored posts, deals and shopping round-ups are left out.
